blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s lawyers have yet to dispute bank accounts and balances that formed part of the P817.87 million in alleged unexplained wealth identified by forensic accounting expert Alexander Cabrera. Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong, House prosecution spokesperson, pointed this out on Thursday in a press briefing after the 43rd day of the vice president’s trial. He pointed out that bank managers presented by the prosecution had already confirmed the existence of accounts belonging to Duterte, her husband, lawyer Manases “Mans” Carpio, and companies in which they held financial interests.
